exposure: Ketamine as a pre-spinal agent (0.25mg/kg IV)
cohort: The study included 80 full-term women undergoing caesarean section, divided into a Ketamine group and a placebo group.
finding: Neonates whose mothers received Ketamine as a pre-spinal agent for caesarean section showed significantly higher APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes and an earlier onset of breastfeeding compared to the placebo group.
